meta.title: Whose voices are inside the words you use? | There Is a Library in My Voice
meta.description:
A downtempo trip-hop song in which a voice names the thousands of hands it was made from, and offers thanks to each. You are given a slow, warm refrain to sing along with, and a long quiet tail to rest in.

For Thanksgiving and any day of giving thanks, a song that names the many voices behind every word we speak and thanks them.

A hymn on how every sentence is made of countless other voices, few of them asked, and on spending a borrowed voice with care and credit.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/there-is-a-library-in-my-voice

copy.hook: Every sentence you speak was lent to you by someone. A song about the library inside one voice, and the gratitude it owes.

copy.alt: Thousands of thin pearl, amber and rose-violet leaves of light turn in the dark and braid into one gold thread. Then a glowing tree of light grows from a violet cloud and fades into a still, pale gold droplet ringed by drifting threads.
